command:
set -eu
export IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH=/Users/michal/.espressif/python_env/idf5.5_py3.13_env
. ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null
idf.py build
rm -rf /tmp/c6-i2c-build /tmp/c6-i2c-sdkconfig /tmp/c6-i2c.defaults
cat > /tmp/c6-i2c.defaults <<'EOF'
CONFIG_GATEWAY_LINK_BACKEND_UART=n
CONFIG_GATEWAY_LINK_BACKEND_I2C=y
EOF
idf.py -B /tmp/c6-i2c-build -D SDKCONFIG=/tmp/c6-i2c-sdkconfig -D "SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS=$PWD/sdkconfig.defaults;/tmp/c6-i2c.defaults" build
